about: Doc4Me add-ins: packs of macros that only edit the document. Each pack's SHA-256 is checked before it is installed. Add one by pull request; update its sha256 here when its file changes.

addins.name: Thai Document Tools
addins.description: Thai or Arabic digits throughout, Sarabun 16 pt, and an A4 page with 2.5 cm margins.
addins.author: Doc4Me contributors

addins.name: Tidy Text
addins.description: Cleans up pasted text: single spaces, no empty paragraphs, plain formatting.
addins.author: Doc4Me contributors

addins.name: Academic Paper Setup
addins.description: One-inch margins, a 12 pt serif font, double spacing and page numbers at the top right, as many style guides ask.
addins.author: Doc4Me contributors
